unmappedRepositoryFindings.title: Next.js API request bodies are forwarded without route-level Zod validation
unmappedRepositoryFindings.summary: The BFF reads request bodies as text and forwards them; client-form Zod checks do not validate direct requests at the API boundary. This differs from ARCHITECTURAL_RULES.md section 2.2 and needs an owner-approved scope decision before implementation.

unmappedRepositoryFindings.title: Password reset and social authentication are not wired in the inspected UI
unmappedRepositoryFindings.summary: The supplied project scope mentions password reset; the login page shows social-provider placeholders and no reset-password flow was observed. No task ID or acceptance criterion for this behavior was supplied.

unmappedRepositoryFindings.title: Existing agent instructions need a reviewed DMD reference
unmappedRepositoryFindings.summary: Existing Next.js-specific instructions were preserved because the create-only bootstrap must not replace them. They do not conflict with the supplied DMD rules; propose a human-reviewed link/addition rather than appending automatically.
